name: Бюро пропавших носков
about: The bureau's reception room: an empty back wall of small wooden pigeonholes, a filing cabinet with a lamp on the left, a stack of sock boxes on the right. The middle stays free for the heroes.

room.prompt: an empty old-fashioned office reception room seen straight from the front, vertical 9:16. The whole back wall is a grid of many small square wooden pigeonholes, each holding one rolled-up sock of a different colour; a small enamel sign high on the wall in the middle with no text on it. The wall meets a plain worn wooden plank floor about two thirds down the picture; the floor fills the lower third. No furniture, no people, no windows, no doors, no text or letters anywhere.

props.prompt: a tall narrow old wooden filing cabinet with four drawers and small brass handles, seen straight from the front
a small green-shaded brass desk lamp, seen from the front, switched off
a neat stack of three cardboard boxes of decreasing size, the top one open with a few colourful socks peeking out, no text or labels, seen from the front
